message: the format 'sha256={sig},extra' of signature scheme 'sig' is neither comma-separated 'name={placeholder}' pairs with distinct token names nor a literal prefix and '{sig}', with '{sig}' once and '{ts}' at most once
fix: Write the header layout as 't={ts},v1={sig}' pairs or as a prefix and '{sig}', such as 'sha256={sig}' (ADR 0013).
